ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    IfError(Value(ThisItem.FileSizeBytes), 0) > 4 * 1024 * 1024,
    RGBA(241, 245, 249, 1),
    If(
        CountRows(
            Filter(
                colSpSelected As selectedRow,
                selectedRow.name = Coalesce(
                    Text(ThisItem.'{FilenameWithExtension}'),
                    Text(ThisItem.'{Name}')
                )
            )
        ) > 0,
        RGBA(0, 102, 204, 1),
        RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
    )
)

If(
    IfError(Value(ThisItem.FileSizeBytes), 0) > 4 * 1024 * 1024,
    "",
    If(
        CountRows(
            Filter(
                colSpSelected As selectedRow,
                selectedRow.name = Coalesce(
                    Text(ThisItem.'{FilenameWithExtension}'),
                    Text(ThisItem.'{Name}')
                )
            )
        ) > 0,
        "✓",
        ""
    )
)

If(
    IfError(Value(ThisItem.FileSizeBytes), 0) > 4 * 1024 * 1024,
    "画像のサイズが4MBを超えています。",
    "アップロード: " & IfError(Text(ThisItem.Modified, DateTimeFormat.ShortDateTime), "-")
)
